name: General
applies_to: All companies except banks: trading, manufacturing, property, services, holding companies.

rows.label: Revenue
rows.hint: Revenue, turnover, sales, total income (banks: total income)

rows.label: Cost of Goods Sold
rows.hint: The gross expense: cost of sales / cost of revenue as printed; negative. Not printed: with expenses by nature, leave it out (the program adds raw materials, employee benefits and depreciation); otherwise judge which expense lines are the cost of earning the revenue and give their sum, source labels joined with ' + ' (a bank, finance or insurance company: e.g. financial cost associated with financial income + provision for credit losses + insurance service expenses + operating costs)

rows.label: Raw Materials & Consumables Used
rows.hint: Expenses by nature: raw materials, consumables used and changes in inventories, as one figure; negative

rows.label: Employee Benefits Expenses
rows.hint: Expenses by nature: employee benefits expense / staff costs on the face of the statement; negative

rows.label: Gross Profit
rows.hint: Gross profit as printed. Leave out when not printed: the program calculates revenue + cost of goods sold, so it is never blank

rows.label: Other Income
rows.hint: Other income, other operating income, other gains (net)

rows.label: Distribution & Selling Expenses
rows.hint: Distribution, selling, marketing expenses; negative

rows.label: Administrative Expenses
rows.hint: Administrative / general and administrative expenses; negative

rows.label: Other Operating Expenses
rows.hint: Other operating expenses, other losses, impairment losses on financial assets (not the raw materials, employee benefits or D&A lines captured separately); negative

rows.label: Operating Profit
rows.hint: Operating profit / results from operating activities / EBIT, if reported

rows.label: Finance Income
rows.hint: Finance income, interest income (non-bank)

rows.label: Finance Costs
rows.hint: Finance costs, finance expenses, interest expense (non-bank); negative

rows.label: Share of Results of Associates
rows.hint: Share of profit/(loss) of associates, net of tax

rows.label: Share of Results of Joint Ventures
rows.hint: Share of profit/(loss) of joint ventures, net of tax

rows.label: Exceptional Items
rows.hint: Exceptional / non-recurring items shown separately on the face of the statement

rows.label: Profit Before Tax
rows.hint: Profit/(loss) before tax / before income tax

rows.label: Taxation
rows.hint: Income tax expense / tax credit; expense negative

rows.label: Profit After Tax
rows.hint: Profit/(loss) for the year/period from continuing + discontinued operations

rows.label: Profit from Discontinued Operations
rows.hint: Profit/(loss) from discontinued operations, net of tax

rows.label: Profit Attributable to Shareholders
rows.hint: Profit attributable to owners/equity holders of the Company

rows.label: Minority Interests
rows.hint: Profit attributable to non-controlling interests

rows.label: Attributable to Perpetual Securities Holders
rows.hint: Attributable to perpetual securities / capital securities holders, if any

rows.label: EPS - Basic (cents)
rows.hint: Basic earnings per share; convert to cents if stated in dollars

rows.label: EPS - Diluted (cents)
rows.hint: Diluted earnings per share; convert to cents if stated in dollars

rows.label: Depreciation & Amortisation
rows.hint: Depreciation and amortisation: the income statement line(s) when shown, else the total from the cash flow statement adjustments; positive

rows.label: Property, Plant & Equipment
rows.hint: PPE, including right-of-use assets if not shown separately

rows.label: Right-of-Use Assets
rows.hint: Right-of-use assets, if shown separately

rows.label: Intangible Assets & Goodwill
rows.hint: Intangible assets, goodwill

rows.label: Associated Companies
rows.hint: Investments in associates

rows.label: Joint Ventures
rows.hint: Investments in joint ventures

rows.label: Long-Term Investments
rows.hint: Financial assets at FVOCI/FVTPL/amortised cost (non-current), other investments

rows.label: Other Non-Current Assets
rows.hint: Other receivables, prepayments, derivatives, etc. (non-current)

rows.label: Inventories
rows.hint: Inventories / stocks; include development properties if that is the main stock

rows.label: Trade & Other Receivables
rows.hint: Trade and other receivables, contract assets

rows.label: Short-Term Investments
rows.hint: Financial assets (current), short-term investments, fixed deposits > 3 months

rows.label: Cash & Cash Equivalents
rows.hint: Cash and bank balances, cash and cash equivalents

rows.label: Other Current Assets
rows.hint: Prepayments, derivatives, tax recoverable, other current assets

rows.label: Trade & Other Payables
rows.hint: Trade and other payables, accruals, contract liabilities

rows.label: Short-Term Borrowings
rows.hint: Loans and borrowings (current), bank overdrafts, current lease liabilities if bundled

rows.label: Lease Liabilities (Current)
rows.hint: Current lease liabilities, if shown separately

rows.label: Current Tax Payable
rows.hint: Income tax payable / provision for taxation

rows.label: Other Current Liabilities
rows.hint: Provisions, derivatives, liabilities held for sale, other current liabilities

rows.label: Long-Term Borrowings
rows.hint: Loans and borrowings (non-current), bonds, notes

rows.label: Lease Liabilities (Non-Current)
rows.hint: Non-current lease liabilities, if shown separately

rows.label: Other Non-Current Liabilities
rows.hint: Provisions, other payables, derivatives (non-current)

rows.label: Net Assets
rows.hint: Total assets minus total liabilities

rows.label: Treasury Shares
rows.hint: Negative

rows.label: Reserves
rows.hint: Retained earnings + all other reserves combined (if reported separately, sum them)

rows.label: Perpetual Securities
rows.hint: Perpetual / capital securities classified as equity

rows.label: Total Shareholders' Equity
rows.hint: Equity attributable to owners of the Company

rows.label: Minority Interests
rows.hint: Non-controlling interests

rows.label: Profit Before Tax
rows.hint: Starting line of the indirect method (profit before tax or profit for the period)

rows.label: Depreciation & Amortisation
rows.hint: Sum of depreciation and amortisation add-backs

rows.label: Other Non-Cash Adjustments
rows.hint: All other adjustments (interest, impairments, gains/losses, share of associates...) combined

rows.label: Operating Cash Flow Before Working Capital Changes
Working Capital Changes
rows.hint: Total of changes in inventories, receivables, payables, etc.

rows.label: Interest Paid
rows.hint: Only if classified in operating activities; negative

rows.label: Interest Received
rows.hint: Only if classified in operating activities

rows.label: Income Tax Paid
rows.hint: Negative

rows.label: Purchase of Property, Plant & Equipment
rows.hint: Capex incl. investment properties and intangibles if combined; negative

rows.label: Acquisition of Subsidiaries / Investments
rows.hint: Acquisition of subsidiaries net of cash, investments in associates/JVs/financial assets; negative

rows.label: Proceeds from Borrowings
rows.hint: Proceeds from borrowings, bonds, debentures and subordinated debt issued

rows.label: Repayment of Borrowings
rows.hint: Repayment of borrowings, redemption of bonds / debentures / subordinated debt; negative

rows.label: Payment of Lease Liabilities
rows.hint: Principal portion of lease payments; negative

rows.label: Interest Paid (Financing)
rows.hint: Interest paid in financing activities, incl. interest on bonds / subordinated debt; negative

rows.label: Dividends Paid
rows.hint: To owners and non-controlling interests combined (incl. dividend tax); negative

rows.label: Purchase of Treasury Shares
rows.hint: Negative

rows.label: Other Financing Activities
rows.hint: Other financing flows (e.g. minority interest contributions)

rows.label: Free Cash Flow
rows.hint: Leave null; computed by the program as net operating cash flow + capex
